<thought>The mass spectrum shows a protonated ion at m/z 182.0732, giving a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈181.066 Da. Using the nitrogen rule (odd nominal mass → odd number of nitrogens) and matching the exact mass, the formula C₉H₁₁NO₃ fits best (calculated neutral mass 181.0739 Da, within typical measurement error).</thought>
<final_answer>C9H11NO3</final_answer>
